# Keka | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Integrated Human Rights, Staff Experience-oriented, Pay, Recruitment, Performance and Project Hours Platform. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competition boundary | Local remuneration and taxation in Hong Kong are not core evidence; global prices are not transparent; PSA, ATS, etc., need to be confirmed along the permitted boundary between the underlying HCM. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Local remuneration and taxation in Hong Kong are not core evidence; global prices are not transparent; and the permitted boundaries between modules such as PSA, ATS and the base HCM need to be confirmed. |
